downloads_q1_2025.definition: Global short-drama app downloads in Q1 2025, over 370 million; not unique users

us_iap_share.definition: US share of estimated global short-drama app in-app purchases, Q1 2025

sea_downloads.definition: Southeast Asia short-drama app downloads, Q1 2025, nearly 87 million

limits: Users of literature and drama can overlap. Do not add the groups or interpret their difference as new reachable viewers.
Survey user counts and app monthly active users have different periods and methodologies.
Downloads are not deduplicated people. Store IAP estimates exclude advertising, third-party Android stores and direct web payments.
Market totals do not predict the audience, earnings or production cost of any individual project.
No verified evidence supports ten times as many drama viewers as novel readers, ten million professional novel workers, or the share who can write scripts.
